scope: Four recorded single Close comparisons in Raid A; metadata and original file membership/hash checks only, no UI actions and no production changes.

timeSemantics.stateReturnedAt: Root records completion/return of the action plus immediate state query; includes automation and screenshot overhead.
timeSemantics.inputRecordedAt: Root action-log timestamp, not an independent measurement of physical OS injection time.
timeSemantics.beforeArchiveToCloseInput: Observed/archive-to-request gap; excludes time elapsed between actual capture and archiving.
timeSemantics.archiveToArchive: Difference between two archive markers; useful observation span, not an exact capture interval.
timeSemantics.closeInputToAfterReturn: Action/state-return latency; not the actual screenshot-to-screenshot interval.
timeSemantics.archivedAt: Root records when the returned state images were saved; not a source-provided pixel-capture timestamp.

comparisons.beforeReturnLimitation: Stable-before is a read-only snapshot, not a named input action; input-actions.json contains no distinct return time for it. Use archive time as the known metadata bound, not as an exact capture time.

earlierContextOriginal.choice: First unchanged original in indexed state. The second original has no separately recorded capture timestamp and is not an independent timed observation.

comparisons.earlierContextLimitation: Not the selected direct comparison baseline. Stable-before provides the later, closer observation before the single Close click; timing metadata alone cannot confirm whether the earlier context was interrupted by gameplay.

recordedState: Root reports Raid A ended and main menu confirmed; B/C not started. Later RDP lock does not alter earlier indexed evidence.
limits: No continuous video or pixel-capture timestamps present.
Zero intervening recorded inputs does not by itself exclude autonomous game events; visual/raid-log evidence must independently confirm a valid ammunition comparison.
No full profiles or private identifiers included.
